sources.entry: Are you ready for production? - Slides

summary.name: Are you ready for production?
summary.one_liner: A slide deck (by rakyll) presenting a checklist of production-readiness practices for services, covering SLOs, dependencies, configuration, releases and rollbacks, monitoring, security, and team culture.
use_cases: Reviewing a service before launching to production
Designing SLOs and dependency availability expectations
Planning canary releases and rollback procedures
Setting up monitoring, alerting and dashboards for a service
Auditing security basics such as IAM, subnetworks and ACLs
Running production readiness discussions with a team
summary.what_it_does: The slides list practical production-readiness practices grouped by area. Design-time guidance includes defining SLOs and documenting external dependency availability to avoid single points of failure. Release guidance covers documenting canary and revert processes and ensuring rollbacks use the same process as rollouts. Operations guidance covers metrics, dashboards, alerting on external dependencies, and propagating distributed trace headers. Security guidance covers IAM, network isolation, VPN use, user data access monitoring, and ACL-limited debugging endpoints. The deck also advises on resource quotas, load tests, and building a culture of early readiness discussions.
notable: Checklist format covering design, release, monitoring, security and team practices
Emphasises rollbacks using the same process as rollouts
Covers dependency availability and avoiding single points of failure
caveats: Slide text is terse and partially extracted; some items are fragmentary
Not a tool; it is a set of guidelines with no software platform
